selected_bottleneck: changeset-durable-id-binding-integrity（持久化变更集 ID 绑定完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main selects a durable changeset file by the caller-supplied id, but get/apply did not prove that the JSON body's own id still matched that selected artifact. Rewriting only doc.id left the same file address and all effectful semantics usable while returned/audited identity diverged from the artifact actually selected.（最新主分支按调用方传入的 id 选择持久化变更集文件，但 get/apply 未证明 JSON 内部 id 仍与被选工件一致；仅改写 doc.id 即可让文件地址与实际执行保持不变，却让返回/审计身份漂移。）
decision_basis: The artifact id is already the storage selector and a required v0.3 contract field, so binding the document body back to the selected file id preserves existing identity semantics rather than inventing a new trust model.（工件 id 已同时是存储选择器与 v0.3 必填契约字段，本轮只是绑定两者，不引入新的信任模型。）
A bounded real-file replay directly reproduced the mismatch: the pre-fix loader accepted a JSON body whose id differed from the requested file id.（有界真实文件重放直接复现：修复前加载器接受内部 id 与请求文件 id 不一致的 JSON。）
changes: Make ChangesetStore.get fail closed with CHANGESET_ID_MISMATCH when a durable document's id differs from the requested artifact id.（当持久化文档内部 id 与请求工件 id 不一致时，ChangesetStore.get 以 CHANGESET_ID_MISMATCH 失败关闭。）
Because apply/rollback already load through get, the same identity proof now precedes both effectful boundaries without duplicating policy.（apply/rollback 已经通过 get 加载，因此同一身份证明自动前置于两个副作用边界。）
Add a regression covering get and apply with a rewritten internal id.（新增覆盖 get 与 apply 的内部 id 改写回归。）

truth_boundary: This binds the durable document's declared id to its selected storage identity. It does not authenticate other coherently rewritten metadata/content, introduce signatures/MACs, or claim crash-atomic application.（本轮只绑定持久化文档声明 id 与存储选择身份；不认证其他可一致改写的元数据/内容，不引入签名或消息认证码，也不声称崩溃原子性。）
